note: Frozen before any STEP 6-2 GPU output (real 3B validation, basis, pilot, main). The evaluation must use this preregistration; a change requires a new version with a recorded reason.

revision.reason: On the GPU server (torch 2.14.1+cu132, with transformers 5.23.0 and again with 5.22.2) the first stage stopped in the CPU self-test experiments/step6_contribution/selftest_run.py --model (float32): the check "the no-intervention row does not depend on the other rows" compared the no-intervention row of an 18-row batch with a separate batch-1 run at a float32 margin tolerance of 1e-5. A different batch size uses different CPU kernels, so the last digits can differ; the check passed locally. The experiment never compares across batch sizes (every Delta m uses the no-intervention row of the same batch, as STEP 5-3B), and vector leakage into lambda-0 rows is already checked bit for bit by the locality check, which passed on the server. No real-model stage had run: the real 3B validation, basis, pilot and main produced no output.
changes: selftest_run.py: the check compares the no-intervention row with the no-intervention row of a same-size batch whose rows are all without intervention, and requires bit-identical margins and text (stricter than the former 1e-5).
revision.unchanged: preregistration, design, verification thresholds, stop conditions, plan files, every other code file

preregistration.decided_by: user, 2026-11-14 (STEP 6 instruction): data sources for the P basis and the mean difference, no centering, 90% explained energy (95% and a fixed rank as sensitivity), random directions averaged over draws seeded by the input ID, mean difference at raw and matched size, primary population, hypotheses H1 / H2 with minimum effect 0.25, the decision structure of STEP 5-3B, side-effect rule, stop conditions. The fixed rank (64) and the number of random draws (5) were set by the implementation before any STEP 6-2 GPU output.
preregistration.reuse: This is a preregistered follow-up experiment that reuses existing data. The confirmation-half inputs (STEP 5-2b images and baseline outputs, STEP 5-3 split by N image, seed 53) were already used for the STEP 5-3B decision (B-H2: boosting attention to N in band 21-24 lowered the margin of False-Yes inputs, robust support), and the band L21-24 itself was selected in STEP 5-3B on the selection half. The result is therefore not an independent confirmation. Independent confirmation requires new images or another model.
preregistration.scope: Tests whether amplifying the N image's own attention-output contribution at the question tokens of layers 21-24 lowers the Yes - No margin of False-Yes inputs more than a random direction of the same size (H1), and whether the part of that contribution orthogonal to the subspace spanned by P-image contributions lowers it more than the part inside that subspace (H2). The N location is taken from the ground truth (oracle); this is a mechanism test, not a deployable correction.

data.split: STEP 5-3 halves by N image ID, seed 53 (configs/data/step5_causal_split.yaml, data/step5_causal)
data.primary_population: confirmation-half one-N inputs answered Yes in the 5-2b main run (False-Yes; the STEP 5-3B boost population): 2,501 items, 3-5 images, every N position
data.side_effect_population: confirmation-half STEP 5-2 All-P inputs with 3-5 images answered Yes in the 5-2 main run: 1,985 items (7,931 item x slot batches)
data.selection_half: used only for the pilot (integrity and timing); never for choosing a setting
data.basis_pool: STEP 3 exploration pool: the 2,332 unique STEP 1-3 inputs (3 images; 20 classes; 8 P and 8 N images per class; 310 images) in data/balanced3/inference_cases (A and B modes; compositions PPP, PPN, PNP, NPP, PNN, NNN). Overlap with the 5-2, 5-2b and 5-3 input images is 0 by COCO id and by file SHA-256 (data/step6_contribution/plan_check.json).

preregistration.contribution: c_i[l, t] = W_O concat_h sum_{j in image i's image-pad tokens} A[h, t, j] v[h, j] in the o_proj output space (the model's o_proj has no bias), for layers l = 21-24 (0-based 20-23) and question tokens t (after the last image's vision_end through the last input token; 26-28 tokens; the STEP 5-3B post-image query). A and v are recomputed from a no-intervention forward (full prefill, batch 1, no cache) with the model's projections, mrope, mask and scaling; softmax and weighted sums in float32 (experiments/step6_contribution/contribution.py, validated in STEP 6-1).

intervention.site: output of the attention module (after o_proj, before the residual add) of layers 21-24, at every question token; generated tokens are not modified directly
intervention.formula: o'[l, t] = o[l, t] + lambda * v[l, t], added in float32 and cast back to the model dtype (bf16)
intervention.strength_note: With v = c_N the N image's contribution becomes 4 times its size, without renormalizing attention; this is not the STEP 5-3B boost (+log 4 on attention logits, renormalized).
intervention.vector_source: c_N from a separate no-intervention forward of the same input; the same stored vector is added in every layer whatever the earlier-layer additions do
intervention.computation: STEP 5-3B fast path (src/core/causal_runtime.Runner): the prefix through the last image's vision_end is computed once with a KV cache; the question tokens are recomputed for all conditions of an (item, slot) in one batch with the no-intervention row in the same batch; greedy generation (max 8 new tokens, the model's repetition penalty 1.05) continues from the intervened state.

conditions.parallel: v = U U^T c_N (U: the layer's P-subspace basis; v90 primary)
conditions.orthogonal: v = (I - U U^T) c_N, so parallel + orthogonal = full
conditions.random: v[l, t] = ||c_N[l, t]|| g / ||g||, g ~ N(0, I_2048) independently per layer and token; 5 draws per (item, slot); generator seed = the first 60 bits of SHA-256('step6|<item_id>|slot<s>|draw<r>'); Delta m(Random) and the Random answer change are the means over the 5 draws of the same input
conditions.mean_difference: raw: v = mu_N - mu_P at every question token; size-matched: v[l, t] = (mu_N - mu_P) / ||mu_N - mu_P|| * ||c_N[l, t]||
conditions.size_matched_parallel_orthogonal: parallel and orthogonal rescaled per token to ||c_N[l, t]|| (secondary); a token whose component is below 1e-12 of ||c_N|| gets a zero vector and is counted
conditions.primary_comparison_size: original sizes (parallel + orthogonal = full is preserved); size-matched comparisons are secondary

p_subspace.source: every P-slot contribution of every STEP 3 pool input whose reconstruction check passes (3,894 P slots x question tokens), per layer
p_subspace.centering: none: decomposition of the second moment about the origin (explained share = energy share)
p_subspace.method: eigendecomposition (float64) of M = sum c c^T accumulated over all vectors; equal to the right singular vectors of the stacked vectors; U = the top-k eigenvectors
p_subspace.dimension_primary: v90: the smallest k whose cumulative energy share is >= 0.90
p_subspace.fitted_once: on the GPU server before the pilot; basis.pt is hashed in basis_check.json and the pilot and main run must load the same file

mean_difference.source: STEP 3 pool inputs containing both P and N images (1,539 inputs: P+P+N, P+N+P, N+P+P, P+N+N) whose reconstruction check passes
mean_difference.mu_N: mean N-slot contribution over N slots and question tokens (1,923 N slots, 157 N images)
mean_difference.mu_P: mean P-slot contribution over P slots and question tokens of the same inputs (2,694 P slots)
mean_difference.sufficiency: At least 5 N images in each of the 20 classes and at least 1,000 N slots, 1,000 P slots in mixed inputs and 1,000 P slots for the basis (met before the run: 8 N images per class, 1,923 / 2,694 / 3,894 slots). Checked again after reconstruction exclusions in the basis check. If not met, the mean-difference condition is reported as "not prepared" and never replaced by evaluation data.

outcomes.delta: Delta m(condition) = intervened margin - no-intervention margin of the same batch

preregistration.exclusion: An item is excluded from every analysis, with counts by reason, if (1) its extraction record is missing, (2) its reconstruction check fails at any of the four layers, or (3) the no-intervention row of its batch answers differently from the baseline answer (as STEP 5-3 frozen v2).

H1.name: the N image's own contribution corrects False-Yes beyond a random change of the same size
H1.contrast: D1 = Delta m(Full N) - Delta m(Random)

H2.name: the correction is carried by the part of the N contribution outside the P-contribution subspace
H2.contrast: D2 = Delta m(Orthogonal) - Delta m(Parallel), basis v90, original sizes

hypotheses.weighting: each item equal weight; image counts and N positions pooled
hypotheses.note: H1 and H2 are decided separately; neither changes any STEP 5 decision.

minimum_effect.confirmed_by: user, 2026-11-14 (0.25); reviewed by the implementation and kept
minimum_effect.rationale: Two bf16 margin steps (0.125) and half of the STEP 5-3 minimum (0.5), because both arms of each contrast are interventions of the same size rather than an intervention against none. Rows of one batch with identical vectors are bit-identical (STEP 5-3B zero-size rows: exact share 1.0), so the contrasts carry no computation-path noise. The STEP 5-3B boost contrast at L21-24 had a 97.5% N-image CI half-width of about 0.06 on the same confirmation-half inputs, so a 0.25 difference is resolvable.

decision.level: 97.5% intervals (Bonferroni for the two primary hypotheses), N-image cluster bootstrap
decision.joint_condition_note: Support requires both the contrast condition and the N-arm condition (intersection-union, as STEP 5-3B); no further multiplicity adjustment.
decision.supported: (1) mean contrast <= -0.25 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of the contrast < 0; AND (2) mean N arm < 0 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of the N arm < 0
decision.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class-cluster 97.5% CI upper bounds of both the contrast and the N arm are < 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)'
decision.no_meaningful_difference: N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of the contrast > -0.25
decision.otherwise: inconclusive; the unmet condition is stated (contrast, N arm, or both)
decision.reported_arm: always reported with its sign, estimate and 97.5% N-image cluster CI (no decision)

statistics.method: percentile cluster bootstrap; 97.5% for H1 / H2 and the reported arms, 95% for secondary results (labelled)
statistics.resampling_unit: N image ID (STEP 5-3 anchor) within the confirmation half; all items of a drawn N image enter together

secondary.answer_change: share of False-Yes items whose answer becomes No, per condition (Random: mean over draws), and the paired differences full - random and orthogonal - parallel
secondary.mean_difference: Delta m and answer change for the raw and size-matched mean-difference directions; contrasts with Random and with Full N
secondary.size_matched: D2 with parallel and orthogonal rescaled to ||c_N|| (secondary to the original-size H2)
secondary.basis_sensitivity: D2 with v95 and with r64
secondary.breakdown: by image count (3, 4, 5) and N position (first / middle / last): Delta m for Full, Random, Parallel, Orthogonal; D1; D2; Full answer change
secondary.step5_3b_side_by_side: items valid in both runs: STEP 5-3B boost on N (band 21-24, post-image query) vs STEP 6 Full N; Delta m and answer change with paired differences (the two operations differ)
secondary.orthogonal_residual: per layer and basis: ||(I - U U^T) c_N|| / ||c_N|| and the parallel energy share (token means per item), with ||c_N||, ||c_N|| / ||o||, the N attention share and cos(c_N, mu_N - mu_P) (descriptive)
secondary.sensitivity: D1 and D2 including items whose no-intervention answer changed; with the bf16 margin; without items whose baseline bf16 margin sign disagrees with the baseline answer

preregistration.all_positive_side_effect: Every condition applied to confirmation-half All-P items answering Yes without intervention, with the first P image (slot 0) as pseudo-N (primary rule) and with every slot in turn (sensitivity: per slot, and the per-item mean over slots): share whose answer becomes No (95% CI) and Delta margin. A slot-0 share above 0.05 for any condition is flagged as a warning. This simulates choosing a P image as N by mistake. STEP 5-3B used slot 0 or the last slot by 5-2 placement, so its All-P values are not directly comparable.
interpretation: Oracle N location: the result shows what the N contribution can do, not a usable correction method.
The vectors are added at L21-24 and change later layers through the residual stream; the effect includes all downstream consequences.
Adding contribution does not renormalize attention and is a different operation from the STEP 5-3B softmax boost.
The P subspace and the mean difference come from 3-image STEP 3 inputs (prompt 'all 3 images'); the evaluation inputs have 3-5 images.
Parallel and Orthogonal differ in size in the primary comparison; direction alone is compared only in the size-matched secondary analysis.
Images and baseline outputs are reused and the confirmation half already entered the STEP 5-3B decision; this is not an independent test.
integrity_checks: real 3B validation before any other GPU stage: reconstruction (identity, attention, output) and intervention locality on 3 fixed selection-half inputs, fp32 and bf16 (else stop)
basis: every pool input extracted, reconstruction-valid share >= 0.99, accumulated counts equal the valid inputs, mean-difference sufficiency, orthonormal finite bases, basis.pt hash (else stop)

pilot: every row recomputed on the reference path with the same thresholds as STEP 5-3; zero-size rows equal the no-intervention row; every pilot input reconstruction-valid; vector identities (else stop)

main: every planned batch written with the planned rows; no-intervention rows reproduce the baseline answers and margins (STEP 5-3 thresholds); reconstruction-valid share >= 0.99; vector identities; same basis and frozen version (else stop)
image token spans and the post-image boundary identical to the baseline runs (checked for every input before running)
run.json records GPU type, driver, CUDA and library versions and the model config hashes
reported_not_decided: answer agreement over all compared pairs, near-ties included
numbers of excluded items by reason
number of size-matched tokens set to zero

verification.reconstruction_tolerances: experiments/step6_contribution/validation.py TOLERANCES, fixed in STEP 6-1 before any real-model run: identity rtol = atol = 1e-5; bf16 model attention and output rtol = atol = 2^-6; fp32 model rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-5

rules: the real 3B validation (reconstruction or intervention locality, fp32 or bf16) fails
any integrity criterion fails (basis, pilot or main)
the estimated main-run time from measured pilot times exceeds the limit
